title: [COLOR-01] Primary buttons render red instead of purple
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.btn-primary`

Look at any primary button ("Get Started", "Start Free Trial").

**Expected:** Buttons use the brand purple (`--color-primary`).
**Actual:** They use `--color-danger` (red).

title: [COLOR-02] "Watch Demo" button border is invisible
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.btn-secondary`

Look at the secondary button in the hero section.

**Expected:** A visible outline around the button.
**Actual:** `border-color` matches the page background, so no border is visible.

title: [COLOR-03] Nav links disappear on hover
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.nav-link:hover`

Hover over any navbar link.

**Expected:** The link stays visible.
**Actual:** Hover color matches the page background, making the text vanish.

title: [COLOR-04] Navbar background is transparent
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.navbar`

Scroll the page and watch the sticky navbar.

**Expected:** A solid background so page content doesn't show through/overlap it.
**Actual:** `background-color: transparent`.

title: [COLOR-05] "NOW IN BETA" hero tag is invisible
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.hero__eyebrow`

Look at the small pill/tag above the hero heading.

**Expected:** Visible label text on its pill background.
**Actual:** The text color is identical to its own background color.

title: [COLOR-06] Hero headline is low-contrast and hard to read
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.hero__title`

Look at the main "Organize your work..." headline.

**Expected:** High-contrast text using the main text color.
**Actual:** It's colored with the subtle border token, making it faint against the dark background.

title: [COLOR-07] Feature icons use an alarming red instead of the brand color
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.feature-card__icon`

Look at the diamond icon on each feature card.

**Expected:** Icons use the brand purple or a neutral accent color.
**Actual:** They use `--color-danger` (red), which reads as a warning/error.

title: [COLOR-08] "Loved by teams everywhere" heading is invisible
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.testimonials .section-title`

Look at the section heading above the testimonial cards.

**Expected:** Readable heading text.
**Actual:** Its color matches the section's own background color exactly.

title: [COLOR-09] Testimonial card borders clash with the dark theme
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.testimonial-card`

Look closely at the border around any testimonial card.

**Expected:** Border uses the theme's `--color-border` token.
**Actual:** Hardcoded to light gray (`#ccc`), which looks out of place on a dark background.

title: [COLOR-10] Decorative quote mark is a jarring red
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.testimonial-card__quote::before`

Look at the small opening-quote character before each testimonial.

**Expected:** A subtle, muted tone consistent with the design.
**Actual:** It's colored with `--color-danger` (red), which looks like an error indicator.

title: [COLOR-11] "Pro" plan is highlighted with a red border instead of the brand color
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.pricing-card--featured`

Look at the border around the middle ("Pro") pricing card.

**Expected:** The recommended plan should stand out using the brand purple.
**Actual:** It's outlined in `--color-danger` (red), which reads as a warning rather than a recommendation.

title: [COLOR-12] "Most Popular" badge text is invisible
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.pricing-card__badge`

Look at the badge above the "Pro" pricing card.

**Expected:** White text visible against the purple badge background.
**Actual:** The text color matches the badge's own background color.

title: [COLOR-13] CTA banner button blends into its background
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.cta-banner .btn-primary`

Look at the "Start Free Trial" button in the purple CTA banner near the bottom of the page.

**Expected:** The button should visually stand out from the banner.
**Actual:** Its background color is identical to the banner's background, so it nearly disappears.

title: [COLOR-14] CTA banner body text is hard to read on the purple background
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.cta-banner__text`

Look at the paragraph under "Ready to get strated?" in the CTA banner.

**Expected:** Light, high-contrast text against the purple banner.
**Actual:** It uses the muted gray text color, which has poor contrast on purple.

title: [COLOR-15] Footer column headings have no visual hierarchy over their links
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.footer-column__heading`

Compare a footer heading (e.g. "Product") to the links below it.

**Expected:** Headings should be more prominent (brighter) than the links underneath.
**Actual:** Both use the exact same muted color.

title: [COLOR-16] Footer links show no hover feedback
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.footer-column__link:hover`

Hover over any footer link.

**Expected:** The link color should change to indicate it's interactive.
**Actual:** The hover color is identical to the default color — nothing visibly changes.

title: [COLOR-17] Footer copyright line is very hard to read
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.site-footer__copyright`

Look at the small copyright line at the very bottom of the page.

**Expected:** Readable muted text.
**Actual:** It uses the border color token, which is far too close to the footer background.

title: [ALIGN-01] Hero content isn't centered
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.hero`

Look at the hero section at the top of the page.

**Expected:** The eyebrow tag, heading, subtitle, and buttons should all be centered on the page.
**Actual:** Everything is left-aligned.

title: [ALIGN-02] Hero buttons stack instead of sitting side by side
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.hero__actions`

Look at the two buttons under the hero subtitle.

**Expected:** Buttons sit next to each other in a row.
**Actual:** `display: block` stacks them one per line.

title: [ALIGN-03] Feature cards form an uneven, broken grid
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.features__grid`

Look at the 4 feature cards.

**Expected:** 4 equal-width columns in a single row (or a clean wrap).
**Actual:** Only 3 uneven column tracks are defined (`1fr 2fr 1fr`) for 4 cards, so the 4th card wraps awkwardly and columns aren't equal width.

title: [ALIGN-04] Feature card title is centered but its description is left-aligned
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.feature-card__title`

Look at any feature card.

**Expected:** Title and description should share the same text alignment.
**Actual:** The title is centered while the paragraph below it is left-aligned, which looks inconsistent.

title: [ALIGN-05] Testimonial cards are different heights
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.testimonials__grid`

Compare the three testimonial card heights.

**Expected:** All three cards should be the same height regardless of quote length.
**Actual:** `align-items: flex-start` stops them from stretching evenly.

title: [ALIGN-06] Pricing cards are different heights
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.pricing__grid`

Compare the three pricing card heights.

**Expected:** All three cards should line up at the same height.
**Actual:** `align-items: flex-start` stops them from stretching evenly.

title: [ALIGN-07] "Most Popular" badge floats way outside the card
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.pricing-card__badge`

Look at the badge above the "Pro" plan.

**Expected:** The badge should sit as a small ribbon overlapping the top edge of the card.
**Actual:** `top: -34px` pushes it far above the card, disconnected from it.

title: [ALIGN-08] "/month" text sits awkwardly high next to the price
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.pricing-card__price span`

Look at any price, e.g. "$12/month".

**Expected:** "/month" should align naturally with the bottom of the large price number.
**Actual:** `vertical-align: top` pushes it up near the top of the number instead.

title: [ALIGN-09] Footer columns are bunched on the left instead of spread out
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.site-footer__grid`

Widen your browser and look at the 4 footer columns.

**Expected:** Columns evenly spread across the footer's full width.
**Actual:** `justify-content: flex-start` bunches them together on the left.

title: [ALIGN-10] Footer copyright line isn't centered
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.site-footer__copyright`

Look at the bottom-most line of the page.

**Expected:** Centered under the footer, to balance the layout above it.
**Actual:** `text-align: left` leaves it flush to the left edge.

title: [ALIGN-11] CTA banner content isn't centered
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.cta-banner`

Look at the purple "Ready to get strated?" banner section.

**Expected:** Heading, text, and button centered in the banner.
**Actual:** `text-align: left` leaves everything flush to the left edge.

title: [ALIGN-12] Navbar items aren't vertically centered
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.navbar`

Look at the logo, nav links, and "Get Started" button in the top bar.

**Expected:** All three groups sit on the same vertical center line.
**Actual:** `align-items` is missing from the flex container.

title: [ALIGN-13] Nav links are cramped together
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.navbar__nav`

Look at the spacing between "Features", "Pricing", "Testimonials" and "Contact".

**Expected:** Comfortable spacing between links.
**Actual:** `gap: 2px` packs them almost touching each other.

title: [ALIGN-14] Pricing feature lists have no bullets or indentation
body:
**File:** `css/style.css` — `.pricing-card__features`

Look at the feature list inside any pricing card.

**Expected:** A clear list appearance (bullets, checkmarks, or similar) so items read as a list.
**Actual:** `list-style: none` removes the bullets and nothing replaces them, so items look like plain stacked paragraphs.
